decision.rationale: K3B records measured startup-footprint evidence for the reversible Common/Signals/Monitor merge decision. Each scenario runs in a fresh OTP :peer BEAM. Baseline starts only passive arbor_contracts after the pre-start snapshot and must keep owner callbacks at zero. Proposed scenarios start the merged app's non-owner runtime extras, including os_mon, inside the timed action. Boot time is persisted as boot_time_us via System.convert_time_unit/3, never raw native units. One sample per fresh process is accepted because boot_time_us and memory ceilings include explicit measured headroom for CI noise; callback and supervisor invariants stay tight. Production owner applications and package layout stay unchanged. Policy remains candidate/measure_only until manager-owned repeated measurements select the final decision.
